worldcombat.skill.psyblade.summary: Forms an almost invisible psychic blade and cuts at melee range; standing on electric terrain charges the blade, raising its power and crackling arcs along the wound.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.use.0: Land a heavy cut while on the electric-terrain charge
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.use.1: Cut the main target and shove those close by
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.use.2: Sever a foe's guard with an unseen blade
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.description.0: Deals about %1$s contact physical damage to the target; while the caster stands on the electric-terrain charge this segment is x1.5.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.description.1: Steps up to a target within %1$s blocks (dash speed about %2$s blocks/tick), then sweeps a %3$s degree arc.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.description.2: Up to %2$s others take %1$s of the cut, and the main target is shoved about %3$s blocks away.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.extend.on: Extend mode: arc x1.2 and more graze, but power x0.88, +2 ticks windup and +3 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.extend.off: Focus mode: narrower, heavier, faster and cheaper, good for singling one target out.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.timing: Castable within %1$s blocks; after %2$s s windup it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.growth.0: From level %1$s the blade power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.growth.1: From level %1$s power rises to %2$s and the arc widens.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.preference.ex: On (extend): arc x1.2 and graze +0.08, but power x0.88, +2 ticks windup and +3 ticks cooldown, good for sweeping a row. Off (focus, default): narrower, heavier, faster and cheaper, good for singling one target out.
worldcombat.skill.psyblade.preference.ai: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; psyblade is melee, so this is smaller than a ranged move's.
On: prioritise the cut while the caster stands on the electric-terrain charge, where it is x1.5; off: ignore terrain and rank it as an ordinary melee cut.
On: prioritise this heavy cut against targets below four tenths health; off: ignore health in the ranking.
